frozen_manifest_unit.title: Sic1 source-system declaration
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Test whether source-level construct, labeling, and condition details can be declared without claiming sample homogeneity.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Can the Gomes Sic1 source record declare construct, labeling, and stated condition context without asserting sample homogeneity?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Gomes et al. (2020), Conformational Ensembles of an Intrinsically Disordered Protein Consistent with NMR, SAXS, and Single-Molecule FRET, Journal of the American Chemical Society 142:15697-15710.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: Sic1 ensemble, NMR/SAXS construction, and smFRET reserved for independent validation.
Sic1/pSic1 labeled construct and stated TE-buffer condition for the smFRET histogram.

source_objects.native_observable: smFRET efficiency histogram for labeled Sic1 or pSic1, with NMR and SAXS in the broader study.
source_objects.estimand: Conformational ensemble descriptions and relationships among global and distributional properties.
source_objects.statistical_unit: A specified Sic1 or pSic1 construct and labeling/condition context in a reported experiment.
source_objects.spatial_support: N-terminal region of Sic1 and terminal dye positions stated in the Figure 2 caption.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: The paper describes heterogeneous IDP conformations and ensemble modeling.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: The paper uses integrative modeling and reserves smFRET as independent validation in the reported study design.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: Declared context does not certify homogeneity, reliability, or cross-method comparability.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract identifies the disordered N-terminal region of Sic1 as the test case and distinguishes NMR/SAXS construction from smFRET independent validation.
The Figure 2 caption identifies labeled Sic1/pSic1 and gives the stated TE-buffer pH and salt condition for the smFRET histogram.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: This is a source-local construct-and-condition challenge; it does not decide the paper's scientific conclusions.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The cited passages support declaring the named Sic1 construct, labeling, and reported measurement condition.
forbidden_generalizations: Infer sample homogeneity from declared construct and buffer context.
Treat declared context as validation of all modalities.
missing_information: Full sample-preparation detail and all replicate metadata are not extracted here.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Record construct, label, and condition separately.
Do not elevate context declaration to reliability or comparability.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.

frozen_pattern_pass_b.applicability: Applicable: a SOURCE with source_id is supplied.

source_projection.construct_and_condition: Sic1/pSic1 labeled context and Figure 2 TE-buffer condition
source_projection.sample_composition: specified labeled construct; broader paper includes NMR/SAXS/smFRET roles

dependency_chain: No prior Rule dependency is required for F02R01.
frozen_pattern_pass_b.local_claim_ceiling: The source record declares context only; it does not certify homogeneity.
irrelevant_obligations: F04-F07 remain outside a source-context declaration.

analyst_divergence_classification_before.claim_boundary: The analyst records a projection, not a RuleResult or scientific conclusion.
